svg.title: A scatter plot of 360 marks. The marks spread further up and down than across. Many of the open marks, the poles that the template cost on the base model, sit above the zero line.
svg.text: Inside the template, the tuning moves sensitivity
further, and it moves it up as often as down
Each mark is one pole: the instruct model's sensitivity minus the base model's, on plain text
(across) and inside the chat template (up). Open marks failed inside the template on the base model.
